newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE COCOA ENDS OFF HIGHS AFTER RISE ON STG.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE COCOA ENDS OFF HIGHS AFTER RISE ON STG.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended firmer but off highs reached after early gains as sterling slumped against the dollar.
"The market overall's still weak," one trader said. He put cocoa's rise in New York down to a reaction to earlier falls, rather than a fundamental change.
By the close, active December was nine sterling higher at 1,050 stg, compared with a high of 1,059. December volume was 1,562 of the total 4,862 lots.
Sterling recovered ground in late European trade against the dollar, climbing to above $1.57 amid dollar weakness.
